headline: Mexico Crude Oil Exports Fall 32% in September
summary: Pemex exported 389,000 barrels of crude per day in September, down 32% from a year earlier, while $91 oil kept total export revenue near $1.06 billion.
why: Pemex (Petróleos Mexicanos) is Mexico's state-owned petroleum company, and its export volumes are a key gauge of national oil production and fiscal revenue.

impacts.name: Pemex
impacts.why: Lower export volumes reduce the physical shipment of crude from state operations.
